Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports and visualisations, using trusted data to support data-driven decisions. Work with business stakeholders to understand performance objectives and reporting requirements, clarify needs and help develop effective reporting and control solutions. Analyse trends, patterns and anomalies to identify emerging risks, delivery issues and opportunities for improvement, presenting findings clearly to PMO and business stakeholders. Support cost management activities, including forecasting, budget tracking, variance analysis and cost governance, working with Finance and delivery teams to improve financial control and transparency. Support integrated planning and scheduling by maintaining portfolio information, monitoring milestones and highlighting dependencies, risks and priorities.
